def eyes(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    S=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='S']
    L=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j<31]; R=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j>=31]
    return (min(i for i,j in L),min(j for i,j in L),min(i for i,j in R),min(j for i,j in R))
seq=['RIGHT','UP','UP','UP']
for s in seq:
    r=action([s])
    done=r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done')
    print(s,"->",eyes(current_frame),"win?",done)
    if done:print("STOP win");break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
